decision: Use exactly one concrete template route: pepper-01.
rationale: Frato's is an order-first casual comfort-food and pizza kitchen with giant mozzarella stick proof, 1-pound slices, burgers, wings, gyros, halal options, direct OrderStart ordering, call/directions conversion, playful dine-in/gaming atmosphere, catering, and verified Google proof. Pepper-01 is the catalog route for pizza/wings/burger/takeout economics and lets the build foreground product cards, signature/deal stacks, saturated playful energy, and direct ordering instead of fake luxury or reservation-led framing.

business_reality.price_register: $ / $$ casual; Google review capture commonly shows $10-20
business_reality.primary_conversion_path: Order Online via OrderStart / call for pickup, delivery, curbside, dine-in, or catering

rejected_alternatives.reason: Too restrained and bistro/menu-forward for Frato's viral, oversized, order-first pizza/comfort-food energy. Risks generic neighborhood-bistro tone.
Would over-index cocktail-bar/day-night hospitality. Frato's has games/chill atmosphere, but the revenue reality is pizza/comfort-food orders and catering, not nightlife.
Too heritage Italian/date-night/trattoria. Frato's is broader creative comfort food with OrderStart conversion and oversized signature items, not reservation-led romance.
Saturated/chef-forward structure could carry some culinary-story elements, but the catalog route is pan-Asian/Latin/sit-down. It under-serves direct pizza/takeout conversion.

required_modifiers.palette: Keep Pepper's saturated order-first energy; bias red/yellow/orange with black/white contrast; optional small green cue for fresh/halal/wings only.
required_modifiers.typography: Keep playful Cherry Bomb-style wordmark discipline and heavy sans headlines; no serif/fine-dining type.
required_modifiers.cta: Primary Order Online; secondary Call, Get Directions, Catering. No reservation CTA.
required_modifiers.menu: Curated signature product-card grid before full menu/order handoff; include giant mozzarella stick, 1-pound pizza slice, burger of the month, wings/tenders, gyros, halal options, catering. No unverified prices.
required_modifiers.proof: Use anonymous aggregate Google proof: 4.2 stars / 554 reviews, 30 written Highest-filter reviews captured, and review-theme chips. Do not publish reviewer names/avatars/dates.
required_modifiers.heritage_story: Use Since 1975, made-from-scratch, culinary-student training, and captured media-feature proof as a concise trust band after order-first hero.
required_modifiers.motion: Playful lightweight product motion only; avoid heavy animation that hurts mobile speed.
required_modifiers.mobile: Sticky/repeated mobile actions for Order, Call, Directions, Catering; reduce decision time versus the current long mobile pages.

required_sections: Order-first hero with signature food proof and Order/Call/Directions CTAs
Fan favorites grid: Giant Mozzarella Stick, 1-Pound Pizza Slice, Burger of the Month, wings/tenders
Signature/deal stack for pizza, burgers, halal wings/tenders, gyros, monthly specials, desserts/shakes where verified
Google proof band using aggregate review themes and safe copy
Story/trust band: Since 1975, scratch kitchen, culinary-student training, official media-feature claims where captured
Catering / office lunch CTA to FratosCatering.com and inquiry path
Location/action footer with phone, address, hours note, OrderStart, directions, catering
avoid_patterns: fake awards, fake reviews, fake prices, fake owner names, or fake menu items
using reviewer names, initials, dates, or avatars in public copy
burying Order Online under long story/media/catering copy
generic pizza-chain sameness without Frato's signature proof
register_risks: Pepper-01 can become generic pizza-chain if the fork does not foreground Frato's giant mozzarella stick, 1-pound slices, culinary-student training, halal options, Schaumburg address, and Google proof.
Overplaying gaming/bar cues would misroute the site toward nightlife instead of order/catering conversion.
Overplaying heritage Italian would misrepresent the broader comfort-food menu and order-first service model.
handoff_notes: Fork/build should start from templates/pepper-01 only.
Preserve verified links: https://orderstart.com/fratospizza, tel:8478952122, address/directions, https://fratoscatering.com/, and https://fratoscatering.com/catering-inquiry-form/ where used.
Use audit/review artifacts as factual source. Omit or generalize any menu item, price, image right, owner name, or claim that is not verified.
This routing gate does not run fork/build/typecheck/preview/deploy.
caveats: No public copy should use reviewer identities; use anonymous aggregate review proof only.
No fork/build validation was run in this routing gate.
If existing scaffold/template files are present in the site directory, they were not validated by this routing gate and should be checked by the fork/build worker.
